profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer — Full Stack · Angular · NestJS · AWS
profile.summary: Impact-driven Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications across GovTech, Healthcare AI, and FinTech domains. Strong expertise in Angular and Node.js, building modern frontend interfaces and architecting robust full-stack, enterprise-grade solutions. Experienced in microservices architecture, REST/SOAP integrations, real-time systems, and cloud-native deployments on AWS. Committed to writing clean, maintainable, and secure code, driving continuous improvements in performance, system reliability, and deployment speed through robust CI/CD practices.

experience.description: Architecting, building, and deploying scalable end-to-end applications for Kuwait's Ministry of Interior, delivering high-quality features on schedule while upholding strong engineering standards.
achievements: Developed Kuwait's national E-Visa platform using Angular 18, NestJS, and MongoDB, boosting digital visa processing speed and reliability for enterprise-scale government applications.
Architected microservice-based backends with optimized queries, indexing, caching, and real-time WebSocket synchronization, delivering 30% performance gains across REST and SOAP services.
Implemented robust security using OAuth2, JWT, and RBAC for multi-tier access control in high-availability systems.
Mapped client and business requirements, providing customized software solutions involving finalization of product specifications and selection of appropriate techniques.
Partnered effectively in Agile Scrum teams to deliver scalable, secure production releases aligned with government standards.
Supported seamless releases by maintaining CI/CD pipelines and ensuring production stability.

experience.description: Full-stack development of AI-powered healthcare and fintech applications, building responsive Angular applications and designing optimized APIs.
achievements: Built responsive Angular applications with NgRx, RxJS, HTML5, CSS3, and ES6+ JavaScript; enhanced load times by 40% via lazy loading, code splitting, tree shaking, and state management.
Designed and optimized RESTful and GraphQL APIs using NestJS and MongoDB, cutting response latency by 25%.
Automated CI/CD pipelines with GitLab, Jenkins, Docker & AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Load Balancers), accelerating releases by 40% with safer rollbacks.
Boosted reliability through comprehensive unit, integration, and E2E testing (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, Cypress), reducing bugs by 30%.
Implemented robust security protocols, encryption, and data protection in Agile teams using Jira for sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.

highlights: Developed Kuwait's official E-Visa platform using Angular SSR with Hydration and NestJS microservices, enabling secure, real-time visa processing and payment integration.
Architected the full database schema and automated backend approval workflows, ensuring scalability, compliance, and enhanced government operational efficiency.
Implemented real-time status tracking with WebSocket integration and role-based access control with OAuth 2.0 and JWT.
projects.caseStudy:
## Overview

The E-Visa Platform is Kuwait's official system for processing visa applications digitally. This system replaced the legacy paper-based workflow with a modern, secure, and scalable digital solution.

## Challenges

- Legacy system with no real-time processing
- High volume of concurrent applications
- Strict government security requirements
- Need for multi-language support (Arabic/English)

## Solution

- Built with Angular 18 using SSR and Hydration for SEO and performance
- Real-time status tracking with WebSocket integration
- Role-based access control with OAuth 2.0 and JWT
- Automated workflow engine for application routing and approvals
- Full database schema design with optimized indexing

## Results

- **60%** reduction in processing time
- **99.9%** uptime since launch
- Handles 10,000+ daily applications
- Secure, real-time visa processing with automated approvals

Engineered facial alignment algorithms and transformed video frames into optimized signal arrays to enhance processing efficiency and platform scalability.
Optimized streaming and inference processes to reduce processing time by 30%, delivering more accurate and responsive health analytics.
projects.caseStudy:
## Overview

Fedo Vitals is a revolutionary health-tech product that uses a smartphone or webcam to measure vital signs (heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2, stress levels) through facial video analysis using WebRTC.

## Technical Highlights

- **WebRTC** for real-time video capture and streaming
- **AI/ML models** for face detection and signal extraction
- **Angular** with optimized rendering for smooth 30fps video processing
- **PostgreSQL** for health data storage with HIPAA-compliant encryption
- Engineered facial alignment algorithms and optimized signal arrays

## Impact

- 30% improvement in AI inference speed
- Sub-2-second vital sign measurement
- Deployed to 50,000+ users
- AI-driven face recognition with real-time health parameter estimation
